title: Take one thing up with a company
summary: The job reads the thread, drafts the message, stops for the one approval, sends it, waits for the reply, follows up on the date it said, and stops when it is settled.
match: hold them to what they said

steps.text: Reading everything they have sent you. Their own message sets the date, so that is what the reply quotes back to them.

steps.name: email.search
steps.title: Read the thread and their published terms

sources.label: Their message, with the date they gave

payload.subject: Order TC-88412 — the refund you confirmed on 1 September
payload.body:
Hello,

On 1 September you confirmed that my return for order TC-88412 had arrived and passed your checks, and that the refund of £64.00 would be back with me within 5 working days. That date has now passed and the money has not reached my card.

Please confirm today when the refund will be sent, and the reference for it.

If it has already been sent, please send me the date and the last four digits of the card it went to so I can take it up with my bank.

Thank you,
Jamie Davis

steps.text: Sent from your address. I will watch the thread and follow up if nothing comes back.

steps.title: Reply received
steps.body: Two days later they replied: the refund was not raised and they have raised it now.

steps.title: Followed up
steps.body: Five days on, nothing had arrived, so I replied again with the reference and asked for a date.

steps.title: They gave a date
steps.body: They confirmed the refund was sent on the eighth day and gave the reference TC-RF-88412.

steps.text: Settled. £64.00 is back on your card, reference TC-RF-88412, eight days after the first message. Nothing else is needed from you.

steps.answer: Settled. £64.00 is back on your card, reference TC-RF-88412, eight days after the first message.
